intervention: Only inspect_face color and duration are overridden. Both arms retain model decisions to inspect, bind, verify, stop or abstain.
common_feedback: last_executed_action added identically to both arms; executed color/duration are reported alongside current numeric feedback. Realized histories differ.
unchanged: local pose estimator and latent student
fresh upper RGB and crop construction
0.16-radian measured stopping and independent true-orientation scoring
pairing: 40 matched initial physical states and first input images
inference: One prespecified primary exact two-sided paired McNemar success test. Binding, failures, calls, tokens and binding-call histograms are descriptive secondary outcomes.
eligibility: Union of service-affected pairs, no replacement; zero exclusions realized.
stopping: Fixed 80 formal trials; no sample extension based on p-values.
binding_count: Input call producing first applied correct binding, including that input. Strictly earlier observations = call index minus one. Never-bound episodes are separately counted; conditional averages alone cannot establish faster acquisition.
limitations: one fixed sweep and cube only
same history schema, not identical realized history
equal call cap does not equalize compute or latency
no claim of initial visibility or first visual-recognition accuracy
live service may change across historical cohorts; both arms newly evaluated
